name: UK weather warnings
value: 7 yellow snow warnings; none amber or red
summary: Seven Met Office yellow snow warnings for 17 Nov across southern Scotland, northern England and the Midlands
state: At 23:40 UTC on 16 Nov the Met Office listed seven yellow warnings and no amber or red warning, all for snow on 17 Nov across Dumfries and Galloway, Lothian and Borders, North East and North West England, Yorkshire and Humber, and the East and West Midlands (Met Office). A yellow warning across this many regions counts as widespread, so Watch is kept.
